digest.component_or_area: LLM config resolution, model-class provider qualification
propositions: A configured provider is silently discarded when a model id contains a colon, affecting canonical Bedrock versioned ids like anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0
The _resolve_target function treats any model string containing a colon as already provider-qualified, returning it unmodified and losing explicit provider configuration
Unversioned Bedrock aliases (us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6) work correctly while canonical versioned ids fail, creating a false working/broken split based on id format
Bare model ids with colons in version suffixes are mis-parsed by infer_provider, which splits on the first colon and returns a fragment of the model id instead of the provider
An explicitly configured provider must be checked before scanning the model string for qualifiers to prevent any punctuation from overruling explicit configuration
Conflicting provider specifications (configured provider vs inline qualifier) should raise rather than silently discard one instruction
